messages.content: What safety status must the motor be in before operating the robot?
The main power supply of the servo must be off and the motor must be in 'off-power and brake' status.
What indicator color appears on the teach pendant after cutting off the servo power?
The servo power indicator on the teach pendant turns red after the servo power is cut off.
What action must be taken before removing the emergency stop?
You should first remove the accident or cause that triggered the emergency stop before reconnecting the servo power supply.
How do you physically release the emergency stop button on the teaching pendant?
You must rotate the emergency stop button in the direction of the white arrow printed on it so it pops up and resets.
What are the four principles to obey when teaching within the robot movement region?
1) Observe the robot from the front. 2) Follow the operation manual strictly. 3) Consider a backup plan if the robot moves suddenly toward you. 4) Set up a shelter just in case.
Why is it unsafe to assume a static robot has finished its program?
A static robot is likely waiting for an input signal to start moving again.
What should you do if an abnormal situation occurs during robot operation?
Press the emergency stop button immediately.
What are the six main components of an industrial robot system listed in the manual?
The components are: 1) Robot, 2) Electric control cabinet, 3) Teaching pendant, 4) Connecting cable, 5) Software, and 6) Other auxiliary equipment.
Which safety sign indicates that death or serious injury may be caused if ignored?
The DANGER sign.
Which safety sign indicates potential moderate/minor injury or equipment failure?
The WARNING (or CAUTION/ATTENTION) sign.
Why should you never place the teach programmer on top of the robot, claps, or ground?
Because accidental collision with the robot or clamps, or falling of the pendant, can cause personal injury, equipment damage, or unwanted robot movement.
What is the primary feature of the CRP-RH series robot arms?
They are hollow series robots developed by CROBOTP used for applications like welding, handling, cutting, spraying, and grinding.
What electrical cabinet model is designed for the RH series robot?
The CRP-G4-CD60 drive control integrated electrical cabinet.
How does the safety emergency stop board ensure double-circuit emergency stop reliability?
It is independent of the control system and uses imported forced disconnect relays to provide a double-circuit emergency stop externally.
What is the purpose of the built-in three-phase transformer in the G4 electric cabinet?
It provides 380V and 200V isolation for a more stable power supply.
Why does the CRP-G4-CD60 cabinet use a dual room split design?
It separates the power supply room (heating devices with fans/air ducts) from the control room to keep dust and oil out of the control room and prevent component failure.
What function does collision softening perform?
When the anti-collision signal is triggered, the system and drive respond simultaneously to quickly soften the robot and minimize damage.
What type of cables are used inside the robot body to avoid circuit damage?
Special high-flexibility cables designed specifically for high-movement robots.
What is the maximum payload capacity of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
The maximum payload capacity is 8 kg.
What is the rated payload capacity of the CRP-RA09A-07 robot?
The rated payload capacity is 7 kg.
What is the maximum reaching distance (arm span) of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
The arm span / reaching distance is 712 mm.
What is the maximum reaching distance of the CRP-RA09A-07 robot?
The reaching distance is 916 mm.
What mounting orientations are supported for the CRP-RA07A-08 and CRP-RA09A-07 robots?
Ground mounting and upside-down mounting.
What is the noise level generated by the CRP-RA series robots?
The noise level is less than or equal to 75 dB(A).
What is the IP rating protection for the body and wrist of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
The body protection rating is IP54 and the wrist protection rating is IP65.
What ambient relative humidity range is required for CRP industrial robots?
Relative humidity between 20% and 85% with no condensation.
What environmental conditions must the robot installation avoid?
The robot must be kept away from flammable or corrosive liquids/gases, and sources of electrical interference.
What is the program capacity step limit for the CD60-CRX8 PLC?
The PLC program capacity is 10,000 steps.
What is the execution cycle time for the CD60-CRX8 PLC?
The execution cycle time is 10 ms.
What edit mode representation is used by the software PLC in the CD60-CRX8 system?
Ladder diagram mode.
What does sequential execution mean in PLC operations?
Sequential execution means the PLC executes the command list line-by-line step-by-step.
What does cyclic execution mean in PLC operations?
Cyclic execution means the PLC executes from the beginning to the end of the ladder diagram, and then immediately starts again from the beginning.
What is the component symbol 'X' in the PLC system?
Component 'X' represents system input signals.
What is the component symbol 'Y' in the PLC system?
Component 'Y' represents system output signals.
What does component symbol 'M' stand for in the PLC?
Component 'M' stands for internal auxiliary relays.
What do components 'T' and 'C' represent in the PLC manual?
'T' represents timers and 'C' represents counters.
In PLC command lists, what is the function of the LD command?
LD is the command for connecting a normally open contact to the bus.
In PLC command lists, what is the function of the LDI command?
LDI is the command for connecting a normally closed contact to the bus.
What is the OUT command used for in PLC programming?
OUT is the relay coil output command used for Y, M, T, and C components (it cannot be used for input relay X).
What command is used to connect two normally open contacts in series in a PLC ladder program?
The AND command.
What command connects a normally closed contact in series?
The ANI command.
What command connects a normally open contact in parallel?
The OR command.
What command connects a normally closed contact in parallel?
The ORI command.
What is the ORB command used for?
ORB is the parallel connection command for series circuit blocks.
What is the ANB command used for?
ANB is the series connection command for parallel circuit blocks.
What are MPS, MRD, and MPP commands used for in PLC logic?
They are stack memory commands (In-stack, Read-stack, Out-stack) used for multiple output circuits.
What is the difference between the SET and RST commands?
SET holds an operation ON, while RST keeps an operation reset/OFF.
What do NOP and END commands signify in PLC programming?
NOP signifies a null operation, and END signifies the end of the PLC program.
What number base is used to express input (X), output (Y), and internal relay (M) component numbers?
Decimal notation.
What happens to internal auxiliary relays (M) when the electrical power is turned off?
Internal auxiliary relays (M) are cleared when power is turned off.
How is the constant value K used in PLC timers?
K is used as the set target value of the timer in decimal range from 1 to 9999.
How does a general timer in the PLC behave when its input condition is turned off?
When the input condition turns off, the general timer count value resets to 0 and its contact opens.
How many degrees of freedom (axes) do the CRP-RA07A-08 and CRP-RA09A-07 robots have?
They have 6 vertical joint axes.
What is the repeated positioning accuracy for CRP-RA series robots?
The repeated positioning accuracy is ±0.03 mm.
What is the maximum speed of axis 1 on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
The maximum speed of axis 1 is 440 °/s.
What is the maximum speed of axis 6 on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
The maximum speed of axis 6 is 698 °/s.
What is the allowable torque for axis 4 on the CRP-RA07A-08 and RA09A-07 models?
The allowable torque for axis 4 is 16.2 N·m.
What is the maximum travel range for Axis 1 on CRP-RA series robots?
What is the total weight of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot body?
The robot body weight is 45 kg.
What is the total weight of the CRP-RA09A-07 robot body?
The robot body weight is 46 kg.
What national and international standard governs Mechanical Safety for Electrical Equipment applied in these systems?
What standard corresponds to the Safety Code for Industrial Robots in China?
GB 11291-1997 (equivalent to ISO 10218:1992).
What should be placed around the robot movement area to prevent accidental intrusion or projectile risks?
A security fence with a safety door equipped with a safety pin.
How are physical keys on the teaching pendant represented in manual documentation?
Physical keys are represented using angle brackets, like `<Key>`.
How are screen buttons represented in CROBOTP manuals?
Screen buttons are represented using square brackets, like `【Button】`.
What screen icon status indicates that the servo power is down?
The `【Servo down】` button status.
How do you switch coordinate modes on the teaching pendant?
By clicking on screen icons such as `【Joint coordinates】`, `【Tool coordinate】`, `【User coordinate】`, or `【Rectangular coordinates】`.
How do you invoke program instructions when creating or editing a program in teach mode?
Turn the mode security switch to teach mode, open the program edit interface, and click the instruction category buttons or `<Command>` menu.
What main instruction categories exist in the CRP program command list?
Movement, Logic, Arithmetic, Palletizing, Welding, Assistant command, Visual, Follow, Correspondence, Special instruct, and Bend.
What must you do before entering the robot workspace even if the robot appears stopped?
Unplug the power or press the emergency stop button.
What safety precaution should be taken regarding handwear when teaching or inching the robot?
Do not wear gloves when teaching and inching the robot.
What operation mode speed should be selected when inching (jogging) the robot manually?
Always select low speed / slow mode.
What items must be confirmed regarding the operator before operating the robot?
1) Properly trained. 2) Knowledgeable in motion features. 3) Aware of hazards. 4) Has not consumed alcohol. 5) Has not taken reaction-slowing drugs.
What three checks are required before beginning the teaching process?
Check: 1) Movement of robot is normal, 2) Zero point/home point calibration is correct, 3) Auxiliary equipment is functioning normally.
What is the purpose of energy saving mode in the G4 electric cabinet?
It reduces standby power consumption and prevents accidental injuries caused by personnel entering the robot area during standby state.
What component in the G4 control cabinet handles high internal brake energy dissipation?
The braking resistance (R1).
What primary main switch label is used for the power disconnect on the G4 electrical cabinet layout?
Main switch (QS1).
What component designation represents the main circuit breaker / air switch in the cabinet?
Air switch (QF1).
What component designation represents the main contactor in the cabinet?
Contactor (KM1).
What module handles drive control integration in the CRP-G4-CD60 cabinet?
The CRP-CD60-CRX8 integrated drive control unit.
What extension module is added to control extra motor axes beyond 6 axes?
The expansion axis drive module (such as CDK2).
Which cable interface designation is used for encoder cable connection on the cabinet?
The X1 encoder cable interface.
Which cable interface designation is used for power motor cable connection?
The X2 motor cable interface.
Which cable interface designation is assigned for welding machine connections in welding versions?
The X3 welding connection interface.
Why are dual switching power supplies used inside the G4 cabinet?
To avoid internal power interference.
What double gas pipe provision is integrated into the RH robot body?
Double circuit gas pipes built in to meet pneumatic needs for welding and material handling.
What is the benefit of the hollow wrist design with a large inner diameter?
It allows water-cooled guns, bellows guns, and cables to pass internally without tangling or interfering during movement.
What is the auto speed default setting icon value shown in manual examples?
Auto speed 10% (`10%`).
What button on the teach pendant interface resets fault alarms?
The `【R】` (Reset) key.
What execution mode runs a program repeatedly without stopping?
Infinite loop mode.
What mode runs only a single line of instruction at a time?
Single line running mode.
What mode executes a program from top to bottom once and then stops?
Single-cycle running mode.
What physical button pauses the active running program on the teach pendant?
The Pause button (`<||>`).
What physical button starts program execution?
The Running button.
What coordinate system measures position relative to the end-effector tool attached to the flange?
The Tool coordinate system.
What coordinate system allows defining points relative to a customized user workpiece reference?
The User coordinate system.
What coordinate system moves individual joints independently?
The Joint coordinate system.
What coordinate system moves the robot relative to the base reference frame in X, Y, Z orthogonal axes?
The Rectangular / Base coordinate system.
What key combination or icon opens hidden system items on the teach pendant?
The hidden menu toggle button.
What is the primary function of the CRP Robot Safety Manual?
It provides detailed procedures, regulations, and safety rules to prevent personal injury and equipment damage during robot operation[cite: 1, 2].
When creating a new program file, what switch must be set to teach mode?
The mode security switch on the teaching pendant[cite: 3].
What happens if you click the 'Servo down' button on the teach pendant screen?
It switches the robot status from servo power down to servo power on[cite: 1].
What icon is used on the teach pendant interface to prohibit axis movement?
The 【Axis prohibition】 icon[cite: 1].
How do you move individual robot axes using screen controls?
By selecting the 【Key movement】 function and pressing the respective axis movement keys[cite: 1].
What interface button is pressed to control an external expansion axis?
The 【Expansion axis】 (Ext) button[cite: 1].
What is the function of the 'Last inst' button in the program editing interface?
It invokes the last instruction that was used during programming[cite: 3].
How do you confirm and input a selected instruction into the program list?
After entering the correct parameters, click the <Inst correct> button to insert the instruction[cite: 3].
What standard defines the 'Characteristic Representation of Industrial Robots' in China?
GB/T 12644-2001 (equivalent to ISO 9946:1999)[cite: 5].
What standard governs low voltage switchgear and control equipment safety?
GB 14048 (All parts)[cite: 5].
What standard covers the 'Principles of Mechanical Safety Risk Assessment'?
GB/T 16856-1997 (equivalent to PREN 1050:1994)[cite: 5].
Why is a safety pin installed on the security fence door?
To ensure that opening the door moves the safety pin and cuts power or stops the robot automatically[cite: 5].
Who is allowed to operate the robot controller in a production facility?
Only a dedicated operator who has undergone official safety training and passed the examination[cite: 5].
What should the operator verify regarding auxiliary equipment before starting operations?
Verify that all connected external auxiliary equipment is operating normally and without defects[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What is the purpose of the Station Box in the G4 system?
It allows operators to control remote start, pause, emergency stop, and station-specific operations externally[cite: 2].
What type of relays are used in the safety emergency stop board to ensure safety?
Imported forced disconnect relays[cite: 2].
What is the main role of the power filter (RC1) in the CD60 electric cabinet?
It suppresses electromagnetic interference from and to the external electrical network[cite: 2].
What components are contained in the power supply room of the split-design G4 cabinet?
Mainly heating devices such as transformers, drives, and braking resistors[cite: 2].
Why is the control room in the G4 cabinet isolated from the power supply room?
To prevent oil and dust accumulation that could lead to electrical short circuits and component failures[cite: 2].
What maximum step capacity does the ladder diagram program support in CD60-CRX8 PLC?
Up to 10,000 steps[cite: 6].
In the PLC ladder diagram, what symbol represents a normally open contact?
The `--| |--` contact symbol[cite: 6].
In the PLC ladder diagram, what symbol represents a normally closed contact?
The `--|/|--` contact symbol[cite: 6].
In the PLC ladder diagram, what symbol represents a direct output coil?
The `( )` coil symbol[cite: 6].
In the PLC ladder diagram, what symbol represents a Set output coil?
The `( S )` coil symbol[cite: 6].
In the PLC ladder diagram, what symbol represents a Reset output coil?
The `( R )` coil symbol[cite: 6].
What instruction is used to connect a series circuit block in parallel?
The ORB instruction[cite: 6].
What instruction is used to connect a parallel circuit block in series?
The ANB instruction[cite: 6].
What does the MPS command do in PLC programming?
It pushes the current logic result into the stack memory (In-stack)[cite: 6].
What does the MRD command do in PLC programming?
It reads the logic result from the stack memory without popping it (Read-stack)[cite: 6].
What does the MPP command do in PLC programming?
It pops the logic result out of the stack memory (Out-stack)[cite: 6].
Can the OUT command be applied directly to an input relay X?
No, the OUT command cannot be used for input relay X[cite: 6].
What components can be reset using the RST command?
Output relays (Y), internal relays (M), timers (T), and counters (C)[cite: 6].
What is the function of an input relay (X) in the software PLC?
It acts as an internal window receiving signals from physical external input switches[cite: 6].
What is the function of an output relay (Y) in the software PLC?
It sends internal control signals out to drive external physical loads[cite: 6].
Are internal auxiliary relays (M) accessible to external physical wiring directly?
No, internal relays (M) are internal auxiliary channels and cannot output directly to external hardware[cite: 6].
What happens to a general timer's contact when its set time K is reached?
The timer contact turns ON (closes)[cite: 6].
What is the time resolution unit of a 10ms timer in the CRP PLC?
10 milliseconds per count unit[cite: 6].
If K = 50 on a 10ms timer, how long is the delay?
0.5 seconds (50 x 10ms)[cite: 6].
What is the payload limit of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
8 kg[cite: 4].
What is the arm span of the CRP-RA09A-07 robot?
916 mm[cite: 4].
What is the allowable moment of inertia for axis 4 on RA series light load robots?
0.38 kg·m²[cite: 4].
What is the allowable moment of inertia for axis 6 on RA series light load robots?
0.16 kg·m²[cite: 4].
What is the maximum angular speed of Axis 5 on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
What is the motion range of Axis 2 on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
From -145° to +80°[cite: 4].
What is the motion range of Axis 3 on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
From -72° to +120°[cite: 4].
What is the motion range of Axis 5 on CRP-RA series robots?
From -120° to +120°[cite: 4].
What is the motion range of Axis 6 on CRP-RA series robots?
From -360° to +360°[cite: 4].
What key features make the CRP-RA07A-08 suitable for small spaces?
Its compact well-knit design and light structure[cite: 4].
What structural feature on the robot body helps users secure external cables and tooling?
Multiple user bracket installation platforms set on the body[cite: 4].
What is the maximum operating ambient temperature for CRP industrial robots?
What is the minimum operating ambient temperature for CRP industrial robots?
0 °C[cite: 4].
What maximum vibration level is permissible in the robot installation environment?
Under 0.5 G[cite: 4].
What field applications are recommended for CRP-RA series robots?
Assembly, handling, machine tending, and grinding[cite: 4].
What document provides instruction on welding processes for CRP robots?
The CRP-Welding Technology Instruction Manual[cite: 5].
What precaution must be taken before powering on the robot control cabinet?
Ensure no person is inside the robot movement region and the area is safe[cite: 1, 3, 5].
Why should operators avoid wearing loose clothing or gloves during teaching operations?
To prevent accidental snagging on controls or machinery and allow quick emergency button response[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What is the meaning of the PROHIBITION sign in the manuals?
It highlights actions and operations that strictly must not be performed[cite: 5].
What is the meaning of the COMPULSION sign in the manuals?
It highlights mandatory requirements and procedures that must be observed[cite: 5].
How are interface menus denoted in the CRP instruction text?
Using square brackets, such as `[Settings]` or `[File operation]`[cite: 3, 5].
How are text keys and graphic buttons represented in documentation?
Enclosed in angle brackets, like `<Enter>` or `<Command>`[cite: 3, 5].
Where are emergency stop buttons located in a standard CRP robot cell setup?
On the teaching pendant, electric control cabinet, and station box[cite: 2].
What is the primary physical shape and color of an emergency stop button?
A red mushroom-headed button[cite: 2].
What happens when an emergency stop button is pressed?
The main power supply to the servo motors is immediately cut off and motor brakes engage[cite: 1, 2, 3, 5].
What indicator button turns red on the teach pendant when servo power is cut off?
The servo power indicator button[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What is the function of the main switch QS1 on the G4 electric cabinet?
It acts as the primary power isolation switch for the entire cabinet[cite: 2].
What function does the fuse QF2 perform in the electric cabinet?
It provides overcurrent protection for internal control circuits[cite: 2].
What is the purpose of the I/O adapter board inside the CRP-G4-CD60 cabinet?
It provides terminal interfaces for user input and output signal wiring[cite: 2].
What interface is used to connect the teaching pendant cable to the cabinet?
The teaching pendant interface port on the cabinet[cite: 2].
How does automatic external power-on enhance operator safety?
It safeguards the operator when their line of sight shifts away from the robot[cite: 2].
What type of transformer is integrated into the G4 electric cabinet?
A three-phase isolation transformer[cite: 2].
What voltage conversion does the built-in transformer in the G4 cabinet perform?
It isolates and steps down 380V to 200V[cite: 2].
What does the safe board (MC circuit) in the electric cabinet do?
It manages safety signals, emergency stop loops, and safety door interlocks[cite: 2].
What is the function of the spare guide rail inside the G4 cabinet?
It allows installation of extra DIN-rail components and expansion modules[cite: 2].
What role do the cabinet main fans play?
They force air circulation through air ducts to cool internal power components[cite: 2].
How often should routine maintenance inspections be performed on the electric cabinet?
According to the daily maintenance schedule specified in the manual[cite: 2].
What battery requires periodic replacement on the control system mainboard?
The mainboard memory backup battery[cite: 2].
What attachment diagram in the G4 manual shows encoder wiring?
Attachment 2: X1 encoder cable connection diagram[cite: 2].
What attachment diagram in the G4 manual shows motor power wiring?
Attachment 3: X2 motor cable connection diagram[cite: 2].
What attachment diagram shows arc welding interconnections?
Attachment 4: X3 welding connection diagram[cite: 2].
In the program interface, what button creates a new program file?
The `【New】` button[cite: 3].
In the program interface, what button backs up a selected program file?
The `【Back up】` button[cite: 3].
How do you transfer a program file to an external USB drive?
Select the file and click `【Copy to U..】` or open the U-disk interface[cite: 3].
What mode allows running a program step-by-step for testing?
Single line running / program commissioning mode[cite: 1, 3].
What safety check is performed automatically when the controller powers up?
System self-test and hardware initialization[cite: 3].
What command group includes motion instructions like MOVJ and MOVL?
The Movement instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group includes IF, WHILE, and JUMP instructions?
The Logic instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group includes variable operations and math functions?
The Arithmetic / Calculation instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group manages multi-layer stacking patterns?
The Palletizing instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group controls arc starting, arc ending, and wave parameters?
The Welding instructions group[cite: 3, 5].
What command group handles vision sensor feedback and alignment?
The Visual instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group manages conveyor tracking features?
The Track / Follow instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group manages serial and network communication protocols?
The Correspondence / Communication instructions group[cite: 3].
What command group controls sheet metal bending follower motions?
The Bend instructions group[cite: 3].
What is the maximum number of steps allowed in a PLC command list execution?
10,000 steps[cite: 6].
What is the execution cycle frequency of the PLC ladder diagram in CD60-CRX8?
Every 10 ms[cite: 6].
What is the primary function of the CRP-JS-YF2-EN-00001-A1 manual?
It serves as the Robot Operation Manual for RH, RA light load, and RA medium load CROBOTP robots[cite: 1].
What must be handed over if the robot equipment needs to be transferred to another user?
All relevant operation, safety, and technical manuals must be handed over to the new user[cite: 1, 2].
What should be assumed about keys or functions not described in the robot manual?
They are deemed unavailable and should not be used[cite: 1, 2].
What risk is indicated by the BEWARE safety sign in the operation manual?
Failure to observe it may cause personal injury and/or mechanical damage[cite: 1].
What safety sign level is used for attention information about robot specifications, operation, and maintenance?
The ★ Caution sign[cite: 1].
Can instructions labeled with 'Caution' result in severe consequences if ignored?
Yes, depending on the situation, ignoring 'Caution' instructions can also lead to severe consequences[cite: 1, 5].
What state must the robot controller be in when removing the emergency stop?
The accident causing the stop must be cleared first before re-engaging the servo power supply[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What principle should be followed regarding robot observation during manual teaching?
Keep observing the robot from the front[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What precaution should be taken in case the robot moves suddenly toward the operator during teaching?
Consider a backup escape plan and set up a physical shelter just in case[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What must be ensured regarding human presence when conducting a test run of a robot?
Ensure nobody is inside the robot movement region and the operator is in a safe position[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What operator condition regarding substance use is mandatory before operating the robot?
The operator must not have consumed alcohol or taken nerve-affecting/reaction-slowing drugs[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What must be verified regarding the robot's zero point prior to starting teaching?
Verify that zero point / home point adjustment is accurate[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What should be done with the teach pendant when operations are completed?
Return it to its original designated holder and ensure it is placed firmly[cite: 1, 3, 5].
Why is it mandatory for system operators to participate in system training?
To learn safety protection measurements and thoroughly understand robot functionality[cite: 1, 3, 5].
What should be done before entering the robot operating region even if the robot is motionless?
Unplug the power or press the emergency stop button[cite: 1, 3, 5].
How are screen soft-keys represented in the manual text formatting?
They are represented inside square brackets, such as 【Key】[cite: 1].
What does clicking the 【Servo down】 button on the screen do?
It toggles the servo state to power on[cite: 1].
What does clicking the 【Servo on】 button on the screen do?
It toggles the servo state to power down[cite: 1].
What is the function of the 【Axis prohibition】 button on the pendant?
It prevents and locks axis movement[cite: 1].
What screen icon is selected to operate in Tool Coordinate System?
The 【Tool coordinate】 icon[cite: 1].
What screen icon is selected to operate in User Coordinate System?
The 【User coordinate】 icon[cite: 1].
What screen icon is used for Rectangular (Base) Coordinate System?
The 【Rectangular coordinates】 icon[cite: 1].
What is the purpose of Single-cycle running mode?
It runs the complete program once from start to end and then stops automatically[cite: 1].
What does the 'Auto speed10%' indicator show?
It indicates that the automatic execution speed limit is set to 10%[cite: 1].
What models belong to the CRP-RH series robots?
Models such as RH14-10, RH18-20, and RH20-10[cite: 2].
Who is the manufacturer of CROBOTP industrial robots?
Chengdu CROBOTP Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd.[cite: 2, 3, 6]
What fields of application are CRP-RH series robots designed for?
Welding, handling, cutting, spraying, grinding, and other industrial automation fields[cite: 2].
How many independent power circuits are used in the G4 cabinet to avoid internal interference?
A dual switching power supply design is used[cite: 2].
What feature of the RH robot wrist prevents hose/cable entanglement during operations?
The 6-axis hollow design with a large inner diameter[cite: 2].
How does the split design in the G4 electric cabinet dissipate heat?
The power supply room uses a multi-group fan and air duct design to cool heat-generating devices[cite: 2].
What safety benefit is provided by the built-in double safety relays on the safety board?
When an emergency stop is triggered, the strong current circuit and servo unit handle it at the same time for a reliable forced stop[cite: 2].
What degree of freedom (number of axes) is provided on the CRP-RA07A-08 robot?
6 axes[cite: 4].
What is the reaching distance of the CRP-RA07A-08 robot arm?
712 mm[cite: 4].
What payload can the CRP-RA07A-08 handle at maximum rating?
8 kg[cite: 4].

8.8 N·m[cite: 4].
What mounting method allows hanging the CRP-RA robot from a structure?
Upside down mounting[cite: 4].
What IP rating does the wrist of the CRP-RA09A-07 robot have?
IP65[cite: 4].
What software component manages user-defined ladder logic in CD60-CRX8 systems?
The embedded Software PLC function[cite: 6].
What is the maximum step program capacity supported by the CD60-CRX8 PLC?
10,000 steps[cite: 6].
What is the cycle execution time for PLC ladder commands in the system?
10 ms[cite: 6].
What are the two basic execution modes of the CD60-CRX8 PLC?
Sequential execution and Circular (Cyclic) execution[cite: 6].
In PLC programming, what does component symbol X denote?
System input signals[cite: 6].
In PLC programming, what does component symbol Y denote?
System output signals[cite: 6].
In PLC programming, what does component symbol M denote?
System internal auxiliary relays[cite: 6].
In PLC programming, what does component symbol T denote?
System timers[cite: 6].
In PLC programming, what does component symbol C denote?
System counters[cite: 6].
